rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent low-rise sports mass in isolation, but across views the stepped roof/body becomes too fragmented and does not convincingly resolve into one clear long-span gym volume. The dominant gesture is weakened by multiple tiered slices and competing roof directions. The blue access edge is not answered by a legible public void or entry seam; the ground response is mostly sealed. Sectionally, the mass behaves more like an abstract cascading object than a gymnasium with a clear-span hall and daylight/structure logic. It does sit within the parcel and avoids obvious geometric collisions, so repair integrity is decent, but program fit fails because the visible section and access relation do not support the gym brief strongly enough.
